title: Quickstart debugging rundown — standup notes
body:
Standup: Quickstart debugging + triage (2026-10-13)
Attendees: Ava, Samir, Jia, Marcus, Riley (remote)
Duration: 35m

Purpose: walk through top quickstart failures discovered by new users in the last 48h, decide immediate mitigations, and line up next-week work to harden onboarding flow. Focus areas: SDK auth UX, example prompts failing with new model variants, telemetry gaps, and sample repo noise.

High-level summary:
- Critical: "npm install" in the Node quickstart still flakes when running on older Node 16 images used by some customers. Repro steps and environment details in GH issue 214.
- Medium: JS SDK streaming example can hang if connection drops during the first chunk — we need a socket-level retry wrapper in examples.
- Low: several sample notebooks reference deprecated model alias "redwood-lite-v1" — must update docs and add lint job to catch aliases.

Notes and discussion (raw):
- Samir: reproduced npm failure on node:16.20 docker image. Root cause looks like optional dependency building native extension (fsevents) — we can add preinstall script or lock package.json to avoid optional native deps for quickstart. Short-term: pin quickstart to yarn v1 and add note to troubleshooting. Long-term: use lightweight container base (node:18-slim) for public quickstart image.
- Jia: telemetry gaps — onboarding funnel shows many users drop at "get-api-key" step, but we don’t have event for "copied-api-key" vs "created-service-token". Adding two discrete events will help find where docs diverge. Logged DX-398.
- Marcus: samples repo pruning — there are ~12 tiny sample apps nobody touched in >18 months. Suggest archive branch and surface recommended 4 canonical samples in README. Also propose adding a "last-verified" badge driven by CI.
- Riley: streaming hang — observed idle socket state causes client to wait forever in examples. Quick mitigation: add client-side 5s overall timeout and show example of a reconnect pattern. Create a small helper function in sdk-shared that examples import.

Decisions made:
- Immediate patch to Node quickstart: switch base image to node:18-slim and add a preinstall flag to skip optional native deps. (owner: Samir, ticket GH #746).
- Add two telemetry events to onboarding funnel and wire them into Quickstarts Playbook analytics dashboard (owner: Jia, Jira DX-398).
- Archive stale samples into samples/archive and update root README to surface 4 recommended examples (owner: Marcus, PR plan drafted).
- Add a reconnect helper in sdk-shared and update streaming examples to import it (owner: Riley).

Action items (owner / ETA / ticket):
- Samir: create GH patch for node quickstart base image + preinstall flag, include CI job to run quickstarts on node:16/18/20. ETA: 2026-10-15. (GH PR: github.com/redwood-inference/quickstarts/pull/746)
- Jia: add telemetry events + dashboard panels; coordinate with analytics infra for schema changes. ETA: 2026-10-18. (JIRA: DX-398)
- Marcus: assemble list of samples to archive, propose canonical 4, and open PR to move archived content. ETA: 2026-10-20. (GH issue drafted)
- Riley: prototype reconnect helper, update two streaming examples, add unit test that simulates socket drop. ETA: 2026-10-17. (GH PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/742)
- Ava: write short "Quickstart triage checklist" doc for on-call engineers (template + quick commands), post under Confluence and add to runbook. ETA: 2026-10-14.

Open questions / backlog items:
- Do we want to standardize a minimal Dockerfile for all quickstarts? (pro: reproducible, con: maintenance) — add to backlog as design spike.
- Should we version-lock example model aliases in quickstarts (e.g., pin to model hash) vs use latest alias? Risk: alias drift causes silent behaviour changes. Proposal: use explicit versioned alias in quickstarts and run weekly alias health check in CI.
- How aggressive should sample archive pruning be? Need to check telemetry (which samples get forks/visits) before mass archive.

Logs and snippets (copied from troubleshooting session):
- Repro command (Samir): docker run --rm -it -v "$PWD":/app -w /app node:16.20 bash -c "npm ci && node examples/basic.js"
- Observed error: "npm ERR! code EBADPLATFORM fsevents@2.3.2" — temporary workaround: set SKIP_OPTIONAL=1 in preinstall.
- Telemetry event examples (draft): event: quickstart_ui_copy_api_key { user_id, session_id, quickstart_id } ; event: quickstart_service_token_created { user_id, token_id }

Notes-to-self (informal):
- We keep getting edge-case errors from community-run quickstarts — small wins (timeouts, pin base images, skip optional native builds) reduce noise a lot.
- Add "How to debug quickstarts locally" section to devexp handbook with these reproducible commands.
- Consider a weekly "quickstart health" check CI that runs each canonical example with a smoke test after every SDK release.

Next meeting: quick triage follow-up on 2026-10-20 (standup slot 09:30 PT). Focus: PR reviews (node image patch, reconnect helper), telemetry event verification, and canonical samples list.

Attachments / references:
- GH issue: github.com/redwood-inference/quickstarts/issues/214 (node install flake)
- PR draft: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/742 (reconnect helper)
- Playbook page: Confluence "DX Quickstarts Playbook" (internal)

End of notes.

-- Ava
